"content": "Without `--idempotency-key`, the CLI mints a fresh UUID for every invocation\nand prints it to stderr before launch (`
Eval idempotency key: <key>`). Each\ninvocation therefore starts and bills a new run. To retry a launch whose\nresponse was lost —
without starting a second run — pass the key that was\nprinted: `--idempotency-key <printed-key>`. A replay is marked `deduped` i

n
the receipt and human output. `--notes` is not part of the key.

##### Imported cases: live tool resolution, and per-run appr

oval

Every file run performs the same live check `eval validate --project` performs,
**before it writes anything**. It is not

opt-in and there is no flag to skip
it. A file with no deterministic `toolCall` steps asks no question and pays no
round trip.

What happens when a deterministic reference does not resolve depends on the
case:

| Case | Outcome |
| - | - |
| Selected
(enabled, and named by `--case` if you used it) | The launch **refuses before the suite is synced** — nothing is written and nothi
ng is billed |\n| Imported, not selected | Its claim is rewritten to `unresolved` (keeping `sourceCaseKey`) and it is **still pers
